newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AALBERTS ACQUIRES FRENCH HAAS ACTIVITIES.
newsitem.headline: AALBERTS ACQUIRES FRENCH HAAS ACTIVITIES.

text.p: Industrial components firm Aalberts Industries NV said on Tuesday it had acquired the activities of French installation materials maker Haas SA for an undisclosed sum.
It said the takeover of assets and some Haas personnel would become effective today.
"The takeover of the activities of Haas S.A. will be financed from reserves and will make a positive contribution to profit per share in the second half of 1997," Aalberts said.

Haas, based in eastern France, was mainly active in the area of installation materials for the French building market. Its activities will be merged with those of Morel S.A., another French company acquired by Aalberts last year.
Aalberts said the new combine, with annual turnover of 120 million French francs, would be market leader in its segment.
Aalberts said that while Haas would continue to operate as an independent company within the combine, the logistic and distribution activities of both firms would be integrated.

"For Aalberts Industries this takeover marks an expansion of its position on the French market and a consolidation of its market leadership in the installation materials segment," Aalberts said in a statement.
